question: Q-W-C1-D4
text: For FY2015, report the sum of stock group revenues, total revenue, and the overlap amount from items in more than one group.
interpretation: FY2015: sum of stock group revenues, deduplicated total revenue, overlap (sum - total), and the overlap computed directly from items in k >= 2 groups as sum((k - 1) * revenue); the two overlap columns must agree.
assemble: WITH ir AS (SELECT wwi_stock_item_id, revenue FROM items WHERE lines > 0), k AS (SELECT wwi_stock_item_id, groups FROM memberships WHERE groups > 0) SELECT (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM groups WHERE lines > 0 AND stock_group_name IS NOT NULL) AS sum_of_group_revenue, (SELECT revenue FROM total) AS total_revenue, (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM groups WHERE lines > 0 AND stock_group_name IS NOT NULL) - (SELECT revenue FROM total) AS overlap_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN k.groups >= 2 THEN ir.revenue * (k.groups - 1) ELSE 0 END) AS overlap_from_multi_group_items, SUM(CASE WHEN k.groups IS NULL THEN ir.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_without_group FROM ir LEFT JOIN k ON k.wwi_stock_item_id = ir.wwi_stock_item_id
note: The overlap check needs each item's group count; COUNTD([Stock Group]) per item is a dimension-table count issued as an ad hoc VDS calculation.
